about: Ticket 1045 decision 3 (2026-10-20): the seven formerly forge-required checks minus skill-lint, grep-e-guard and status-verb-guard, plus the skills-catalog drift check. Run by scripts/merge-gate.py on the candidate merge commit; read from the base revision. Ticket 1221: a bookkeeping-only candidate runs only the tier's checks; policy in skills/merge/SKILL.md § Gating tiers. Ticket 1220: over a bookkeeping delta since a passing record, /verify-gate re-runs only the "rerun" checks and reuses the rest (skills/verify-gate/SKILL.md § Check plan); the merge record itself is unaffected. Ticket 1226: on an open fast path a bookkeeping record runs only the "fastpath" checks and scripts/merge_monitor.py runs the full set on the new main tip afterwards; K is "max_lag", the age bound "max_age_minutes".
